tools.name: Microsoft Copilot
tools.quote: Warwick provides access to Microsoft Co-PilotLink opens in a new window for students and staff.

data.quote: Do not input any personal or confidential data into any AI tools, unless you fully understand what will happen to that data. The university recommends using Co-Pilot chat for this kind of data - when logged in with your Warwick account.
